Entry Water Economy of Dorne Dorne's most precious resource is not gold, but water. Wells, reservoirs, oases and canals determine whether a village can exist, and those who control the water have almost lord-like weight. Travelers see a clear water as a gift, but locals know that there is a long maintenance and struggle behind it. Any break in the place of origin, checkpoints, shipping schedules, debts and protection fees will immediately make the nobles in the distance feel the changes in price and power.

Travelers see a clear water as a gift, but locals know that there is a long maintenance and struggle behind it. Some people turn raw materials into tools, cloth and medicine, others set festivals and taboos for exchange; wealth is piled up by many hands, and rarely belongs to just one name.
